chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: Hi everyone, welcome back to the channel.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: Today we are diving into one of the most popular technologies of our time that is large language

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: models which is also known as LLMs.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: By the end of this video you will have a clear understanding of what LLMs are and why they

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: are important.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: So without further ado let's get it started.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: So what are LLMs?

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: A large language model or LLM is a type of advanced artificial intelligence system.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: LLM is a computer program trained on vast amount of data hence it is named as large.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: It learns patterns, structure and meaning of a language.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: Therefore it generates human-like responses.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: LLMs are built on a type of neural network called transformer model.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: LLMs can perform translation, summarization, coding and much more.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: Examples of LLMs are Chatterbitty, Gemini, Lama, Cloudy and so on.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: Now let's see how LLMs work.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: Actually LLMs are built on type of neural networks called transformer architecture.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: So here are the simple process of how LLM works.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: The first is collection of huge amount of text data.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: That means LLMs are trained on huge amount of text data either from books, articles,

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: websites and so on.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: Next step is data cleaning.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: So before training the model first there is a cleaning of data such as removing duplicates,

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: low quality content, wrong data and so on.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: Another is tokenization.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: In this process text are split into smaller units called tokens.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: For example I love coding will be split like I love coding.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: Next step is embedding which means each token is converted into a numerical vector.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: Attention mechanism.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: This is very important part of using transformers.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: Here the model look to all the sentences, words or figures and pays attention to the

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: most important part of a sentence.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: For example in a sentence a boy fell asleep because he was tired.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: Here he refers to a boy.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: So this is the attention mechanism.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: Next is training on data.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: During the training the model process billions and trillions of data predicting next word

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: and if it is wrong the model corrects its knowledge by referring its huge data and this

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: process is repeated until the model launch proper patterns, creativity and reasoning.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: The next step is fine tuning with human feedback.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: That means after the training process humans give feedback.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: So it learns to give safer and more better answer.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: The last step is inference.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: Once our model is trained we can give prompt to the model and then it generate our response

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: by predicting words one by one.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: For example Tokyo is in then it will predict Japan.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: What are LLMs used for?

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: LLMs are used in chatbots and virtual assistants.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: They are used for answering customer queries, performing back-end tasks and providing various

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: information to users as a part of customer services.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: LLMs can generate code according to user instructions and can also perform debugging if required.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: These days some LLMs can perform sentiment analysis to help users to find customer's

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: intention or a response.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: LLMs are used for language translation.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: If LLMs are trained on various languages it can break the barrier among multilingual environment.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: LLMs are used for summarizing multiple pages of articles, news, research papers and so on.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: Here are some of popular LLMs recently.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: OpenAI GPT family such as GPT 3.5, GPT 4.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: Google's DeepMind Gemini which excels at long context reasoning.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: Meta's open source model which are widely used by researchers.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: Anthropx Cloudy which is known for safety-focused design.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: Google and Facebook's BERT and Robert are good at embedding and understanding tasks.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: Mistral which is popular in open source communities.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: Therefore they are some of the popular LLMs recently and each LLM has its own strength

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: and benefits.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: Advantages of LLMs

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: Scalability LLMs can handle enormous amounts of data.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: Continuous Improvements LLMs can learn and adapt new data continuously

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: and improve the performance as they are fine-tuned.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: Flexibility LLMs are versatile.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: That is one LLM can be used for different tasks such as translation, summarization,

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: text generation and so on.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: Efficiency LLMs make our life easier as they automate

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: our routine tasks.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: Efficiency and Training Many LLMs are trained on on-level data so

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: it is less time-consuming.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: Hence these are some of the advantages of LLMs.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: Now let's see the disadvantages.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: Disadvantages of LLMs Despite many benefits of LLMs, they have

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: some limitations too.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: Data Privacy Risk LLMs process huge amounts of data.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: If there are some sensitive data, the model should ensure its confidentiality.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: Hallucinations Sometimes LLMs can provide false information

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: with confidence.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: So it may cause problems.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: Bias Since LLMs are trained by humans from many

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: sources, they may reflect biases in those data.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: High Operating Cost Cost of operating LLMs can be high as they

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: are trained on large amounts of data and can require expensive computing power.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: Ethical Concerns LLMs may have issues on data plagiarism or

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: malicious purposes.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: Why LLMs are important?

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: LLMs make knowledge easily readable and accessible than earlier days by summarizing long and

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: complex topics.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: They allow people to use natural language instead of complicated commands.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: With LLMs, we have powerful tools such as chatbots, AI assistants, and much more.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: LLMs allow computers to interact in a more natural way with humans.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: Therefore, in this way, LLMs are very important to us as they bring technology more closer.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: Okay, that's all for today.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: We understand LLMs are AI systems designed to understand human language and they work

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: using transformer neural networks and large amounts of data.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: They are important because they are one of the most revolutionary technologies of our

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: era.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: I hope you liked this video.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: If you found this video useful, don't forget to like, share and subscribe my channel.

chunks.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
chunks.text: Thank you for watching.
